north_star.title: Live 0→1 for Q1
north_star.statement: An external agent client installs the TWZRD buyer gate and honors block before the wallet signs — proven by attributable Path B artifacts (refuse-before-sign transcripts on non-TWZRD hosts), not by free MCP hits or day0.gate_evals.
north_star.primary: External Path B artifacts (attributable refuse/allow transcripts)

not_primary.day0_gate_evals: Facilitator settle-gate telemetry only — NOT buyer Path B. Do not chase as external adoption.
not_primary.day0_gate_blocks: Settle-rail refusals — NOT buyer AutoGate signer_invocation_count=0.
not_primary.free_preflight: Advisory only until beforePayment hook is installed.

north_star.success_definition: ≥1 twzrd.path_b_artifact/v1 from an operator we do not control, with BLOCK + signer_invocation_count=0 (matched ALLOW when claimed).

day0.free_card_attribution_note: external is the only demand-bearing number here; internal is our own swarm/tooling and unattributed is context-free, never external
day0.portable_proof_upsell_note: merchant_card path only, interim in-memory counter (per-worker, non-durable, resets on restart) — the preflight path's impressions are durable, see preflight_requests.portable_proof_upsell_trigger instead
day0.paid_trust_payer_note: external = EXTERNAL_VERIFIED_WALLETS only (completed lineage audit); internal = INTERNAL_WALLETS / dogfood; unknown = unknown_pending_audit (default for anything new — never counted as external). Use paid_trust_payer_external for organic conversion, not raw paid_trust_total.

door_zero.note: door-zero funnel: process-local mechanism usage; NOT external adoption (metric stays counted_external guard runs)

live.diagnosis: Infra is live; demand is not. Zero external free cards and zero gate_evals — Path B has no external seat yet.

cf_strategy.decision_summary: Hold engineering on Agents MCP SVM. Flood live x402-hono Solana path. MCP-SVM is watch + optional read-only spike only — not build-now.
cf_strategy.guardrail: Flood Solana volume through live Workers + x402-hono + intel facilitator. Do not pre-build speculative CF Wallets scopes. Do not engineer Agents MCP SVM this week without an explicit spike go.
